proposal.name: filelock
proposal.rationale: The SBOM declares version 4.2.4 for filelock. Registry lookup confirms 4.2.4 exists in PyPI. Version listing before the SBOM timestamp shows 4.2.4 as the highest-probability candidate (0.084), matching the declared version exactly.

proposal.name: pypdf
proposal.rationale: Version 6.21.4 has the highest prior probability (0.333) among all versions satisfying the declared range >=6.21 and published before the SBOM timestamp. It also matches the version_field in the SBOM.
